description: Queue a real order on the user's live MT5 account through the MT5 Bridge EA. REAL MONEY: only call this after the user has explicitly approved the exact symbol, direction, volume, entry, stop loss and take profit. Never place orders on your own initiative. If the result is `needs_confirmation`, show every warning to the user and only retry with those keys in `acknowledgeWarnings` if the user says to place it anyway. Market orders expire if the EA does not pick them up within ~20s; check `get_my_mt5_account` for the result. For market orders, prefer slDistance/tpDistance (SL/TP as a distance from the real fill) over absolute stopLoss/takeProfit — the server re-anchors them to the actual fill price so quote-vs-fill slippage can't skew your risk. Requires a personal SocialForex API token. Create one at /mt5 (section "Connect an AI assistant (MCP)") and add it to the MCP client as header `Authorization: Bearer sfmcp_...`.

acknowledgeWarnings.description: Warnings from a previous needs_confirmation result that the user chose to override

price.description: Required for LIMIT/STOP orders, ignored for market

slDistance.description: MARKET orders: SL as a PRICE DISTANCE from the real fill (e.g. 5 for $5 on gold, 0.0030 for 30 pips). The server re-anchors SL to the actual fill price — use this instead of stopLoss to avoid slippage skew.

stopLoss.description: Absolute stop loss price. Omit if using slDistance, or a default (10% risk) is applied.

symbol.description: Broker-neutral symbol, e.g. EURUSD, XAUUSD (EA maps suffixes)

tpDistance.description: MARKET orders: TP as a PRICE DISTANCE from the real fill. Re-anchored like slDistance.

name: place_mt5_order
title: Place MT5 order
